COMPONENT_GRAPH.architecture_style: single-process Go edge runtime with immutable serving generations, serialized reconciliation, lifecycle-safe shared runtime objects, explicit data/operator planes and durable recovery

identity_contract.endpoint: pool id + canonical network endpoint + transport compatibility; accepted remove/re-add creates a new incarnation
identity_contract.pool: stable pool id plus semantic compatibility fingerprint
identity_contract.route: stable route id plus declaration-order-independent semantic digest
identity_contract.source: source identity + monotonic revision + content digest

COMPONENT_GRAPH.publication_contract: validate, compile, recheck source fences, reconcile runtime state, prepare durable checkpoint body and atomically publish one complete snapshot before acknowledgement

DATA_VOLUME_PLAN.plan: materially varied route/pool/endpoint and independent source snapshots sufficient to exercise reconciliation and runtime lifecycle; generated data does not count as authored-code scale

SCALE_FIT.DEFECT_SURFACE: 30 coherent manifestations across six causal clusters

STATE_MODEL.durability: checksummed generation body plus atomic CURRENT authority with retained previous complete generations
STATE_MODEL.endpoint_state: canonical identity + incarnation + health + lifecycle + inflight + transport/affinity continuity
STATE_MODEL.serving_state: one immutable RuntimeSnapshot leased for a complete request
STATE_MODEL.source_state: per-source accepted revision/digest and complete accepted source material
